report.summary: Both UI tests fail at the same step: clicking get_by_test_id("add-books") in BooksPage.add times out because no element has that test id. The books template renders the button as data-testid="add-book", so the page object's locator is stale. Fix tests/support/pages.py:44 to use "add-book" (or confirm the rename was intended and update the template) and rerun both tests.

causes.title: Page object clicks a test id that the books page does not render
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() looks up the submit button with get_by_test_id("add-books") (tests/support/pages.py:44). The books template defines the submit button as data-testid="add-book" (app/templates/books.html:9). Playwright waits for an element that never appears and raises a 5000ms timeout before any form is submitted. Both failing tests call books.add() and therefore never reach their assertions. The application markup looks intended, so the locator is the likely fault. The one-character-plural mismatch suggests a typo or an earlier rename that was not propagated to the page object. The second test's year-validation assertions ("Year must be between", the kept title value, and the absent row) were not exercised, so they remain unverified.
evidence: Failure call log for both tests: "Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: - waiting for get_by_test_id("add-books")"
Repo search for 'add-books' finds only tests/support/pages.py:44; the template uses only 'add-book'.
causes.suggested_fix: Change tests/support/pages.py:44 to self.page.get_by_test_id("add-book").click(). Better, have the page object use one constant or a role-based locator (get_by_role("button", name="Add book")) so a future rename is caught in one place. Then rerun both tests to confirm the year-validation assertions in test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input actually pass against app/main.py.
